tool_evidence.title: Process input video removing segments to create compressed_video.mp4: $ python3 /root/.claude/skills/video-processor/scripts/process_video.py --input data/input_video.mp4 --output /root/compressed_video.mp4 --remove-segments /root/all_segments.json --merge-gap 0.1

Generate compression_report.json from original, compressed, and segments list: $ python3 /root/.claude/skills/report-generator/scripts/generate_report.py --original data/input_video.mp4 --compressed /root/compressed_video.mp4 --segments /root/all_segments.json --output /root/compression_report.json --merge-gap 0.1 && cat /root/compression_report.json

Verify compressed video streams and validate report math consistency: $ ls -lh /root/compressed_video.mp4 /root/compression_report.json && ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name,width,height,r_frame_rate -of default=nw=1 /root/compressed_video.mp4 && ffprobe -v error -select_streams a:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name,sample_rate,channels -of default=nw=1 /root/compressed_video.mp4 && python3 - <<'PY' import json,math r=json.load(open('/root/compression_report.json')) req=['original_duration_seconds','compressed_duration_seconds','removed_duration_seconds','compression_percentage','segments_removed'] print('keys_ok', all(k in r for k in req)) orig=r['original_duration_seconds']; comp=r['compressed_duration_seconds']; rem=r['removed_duration_seconds'] print('math_diff', orig-(comp+rem)) segs=r['segments_removed'] ok=True prev_end=-1 for s in segs:     if not (isinstance(s['start'],(int,float)) and isinstance(s['end'],(int,float))): ok=False     if not (s['start']<s['end']): ok=False     if abs((s['end']-s['start'])-s['duration'])>1e-6: ok=False     if s['start']<prev_end-1e-9: ok=False     prev_end=s['end'] print('segments_ok',ok,'count',len(segs)) PY

Clean up intermediate artifacts, keeping only required output files: $ rm -rf /root/frames /root/audio.wav /root/energies.json /root/opening.json /root/opening12.json /root/pauses.json /root/all_segments.json /root/silence*.log /root/freeze.log /root/compressed_video_report.json 2>/dev/null || true && ls -la /root | egrep 'compressed_video\.mp4|compression_report\.json'
